title: Red Hat Security Advisory: httpd:2.4 security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for the Apache HTTP Server (httpd) 2.4 module addressing multiple vulnerabilities including heap-based buffer overflows, NULL pointer dereference, buffer over-reads, and denial of service issues. These vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 Extended Life Cycle and related variants. The update fixes an incomplete previous fix for CVE-2023-38709 (now CVE-2024-42516) and several new vulnerabilities impacting various Apache modules such as mod_proxy_html, mod_xml2enc, mod_headers, and mod_mime. The advisory rates the security impact as Important and provides updated packages to remediate these issues.
